allow:
Bash(/dev/null -e "
WITH weekly AS \(
  SELECT
    DATE\(DATE_SUB\(merged_date, INTERVAL WEEKDAY\(merged_date\) DAY\)\) as time,
    additions,
    deletions,
    ROW_NUMBER\(\) OVER \(PARTITION BY DATE\(DATE_SUB\(merged_date, INTERVAL WEEKDAY\(merged_date\) DAY\)\) ORDER BY additions\) as rn_add,
    ROW_NUMBER\(\) OVER \(PARTITION BY DATE\(DATE_SUB\(merged_date, INTERVAL WEEKDAY\(merged_date\) DAY\)\) ORDER BY deletions\) as rn_del,
    COUNT\(*\) OVER \(PARTITION BY DATE\(DATE_SUB\(merged_date, INTERVAL WEEKDAY\(merged_date\) DAY\)\)\) as cnt
  FROM pull_requests
  WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL
\)
SELECT
  time,
  AVG\(CASE WHEN rn_add IN \(FLOOR\(\(cnt+1\)/2\), CEIL\(\(cnt+1\)/2\)\) THEN additions END\) as median_additions,
  AVG\(CASE WHEN rn_del IN \(FLOOR\(\(cnt+1\)/2\), CEIL\(\(cnt+1\)/2\)\) THEN deletions END\) as median_deletions
FROM weekly
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 10;
")
